title: Phone Link cached phone data
whyItMatters: Phone Link keeps copies of messages, notifications, photos, call history and contacts from the linked phone. Anyone with the disk can see who the person talked to without the phone.
source: Microsoft Learn, packaged apps keep user data under %LOCALAPPDATA%/Packages/<PackageFamilyName> - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/uwp/api/windows.storage.applicationdata.localfolder
notes: source uncertain: Microsoft publishes no help page naming this folder; the package family name Microsoft.YourPhone_8wekyb3d8bbwe was confirmed on this PC (Windows 11). Phone Link cannot be uninstalled, but its app data can be reset in Settings. Local cache only; nothing is opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save any photo or file you need from your phone; Phone Link keeps only a local cache of what was synced.
cleanup.signOut: In Phone Link, open Settings > Mobile devices and remove this phone, or unlink the Microsoft account on the phone.
steps: In Phone Link, remove the linked phone.
Open Settings > Apps > Installed apps, choose Phone Link, then Advanced options > Reset.
Delete the Phone Link package folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the local Phone Link cache on this PC. Messages and photos stay on the phone and in the Microsoft account.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Remove your mobile device from Phone Link: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/phonelink/remove-your-mobile-device-from-phone-link-link-to-windows-and-windows-settings
